name: Ember Vale
blurb: A hero who lasts for days. Hunt slimes with whoever is here tonight; your level, gold and name follow you to every device. Go hardcore and a death is forever.

landing.pitch: Your hero keeps every level. The night does not.
howToPlay: Make a hero, or pick up the one you left.
Strike slimes for experience and gold; the King Slime pays best.
Every night ends with a ranking; your hero keeps what it earned.
Hardcore: one life. Fall and you join the Hall of the Fallen.

controls.phone: Drag on the left to move, STRIKE on the right.
controls.computer: WASD or arrows to move, Space to strike.
